The issue was that the `include` directive in your `kitty.conf` was capitalized as `Include`, which Kitty may not recognize properly (even though it's generally case-insensitive, consistency is key). I've changed it to lowercase `include` to match standard Kitty configuration syntax.

To apply the changes, restart Kitty or reload the configuration by running `kitty +kitten reload` in your terminal.

If you want to switch between color schemes (e.g., to Tokyo Night instead of Gruvbox), edit `colors/colors.conf` and change the include line to `include "custom/tokyonight.conf"`, then reload.
